reply.emotion: excited and triumphant, celebrating a great victory
notes: gewinnen is irregular: gewinnt, gewann, hat gewonnen.
Do not confuse gewinnen (to win) with verdienen (to earn or deserve).

senses.definition: To be the most successful in a game, competition, or election.

examples.text: Unser Team will das Spiel gewinnen.
examples.translation: Our team wants to win the game.
examples.emotion: hopeful and determined, cheering the team on

senses.definition: To obtain something desired, such as an advantage, profit, or prize.

examples.text: Sie hat eine Reise nach Paris gewonnen.
examples.translation: She won a trip to Paris.
examples.emotion: amazed and thrilled at such a lucky prize

definitions: To be the most successful in a game, competition, or election.
To obtain something desired, such as an advantage, profit, or prize.
